subject: EdgeHealth: request for nonstandard log retention + BYOK escrow routing
messages:
From: EdgeHealth Security <security@edgehealth.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference>
Cc: Mike Ross <mike.ross@edgehealth.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: 14-day audit log retention waiver + BYOK escrow routing

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week — EdgeHealth is moving fast and we hit one blocker in our procurement review. Our security team needs a temporary exception for two things for the POC:

- Audit logs containing masked PII need to be retained for 14 days (our default retention is 90 days) for quick triage across services.
- BYOK: we need an escrow arrangement for our CMKs while the POC runs (we cannot rotate away keys without notice for the initial 30 days).

Can Redwood route redacted audit exports to our SIEM (S3 -> vendor ingest) rather than rely on the console? If possible we need an evidence path showing exports and an approval matrix. I attached our short security questionnaire and a proposed mutual action plan spreadsheet.

We'd like to get a decision by next Thursday (10/7) so procurement can proceed. Happy to jump on a call.

Thanks,
Mike Ross
Sr. Security Engineer
EdgeHealth

Attachments: edgehealth-security-questionnaire.pdf (pdf, 120KB), edge-proposed-map.xlsx (xlsx, stub)

If it's easier, I can set up a 30-minute triage call with EdgeHealth later this week. Mike — let me know availability.

-David

Thanks for pulling this together, David — quick product/engineering read:

Short answer: we can support a scoped export + short retention override for a POC but there are trade-offs. Prototype options below (ranked by implementation effort):

Option A (fastest, lowest product change)
- Create a per-account export job that ships redacted audit lines to a preconfigured S3 bucket (EdgeHealth-owned). Retention controlled on EdgeHealth side.
- No console retention override; we create an export lambda to run on a 1h cadence for the window.
- BYOK: allow a customer-held CMK for encryption-at-rest of exported blobs; escrow requirement needs legal signoff.
- ETA: 2 weeks for export job + IAM policy + docs (small ops task).

Option B (medium effort)
- Add a temporary retention flag on the account that reduces internal log retention to 14d for certain categories (masked PII). Requires product toggle and audit to prevent misuse.
- BYOK escrow: require API for temporary hold/release; engineering needs to add a control plane endpoint.
- ETA: 4-6 weeks and regression tests.

Option C (heavy)
- Full routed SIEM webhook with per-event transformation + near-real-time delivery and signed attestations. BYOK integrated into runtime vault.
- ETA: multi-quarter.

Questions / Product asks for triage:
- What events exactly does EdgeHealth need in the 14d window? (auth, admin, data-access, inference logs?)
- Does EdgeHealth require streaming (near-real-time) or batched export is OK?
- For BYOK escrow, do they expect Redwood to hold the key in escrow or just a documented hold policy they control?

I'll volunteer to prototype Option A if compliance and legal sign off escrow path is clear.

-priyom
Priyom Das
Staff Product Manager, Infra
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>

Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: 14-day audit log retention waiver + BYOK escrow routing

David / team — compliance perspective:

We can accept a scoped POC exception with the following guardrails:
1) Written temporary exception (DocuSign amendment) signed by both parties that specifies scope (which event types, which accounts, start/end date).
2) Evidence path: export ledger + MD5 checksums + signed delivery receipts retained for 180 days in our compliance store (not full logs).
3) BYOK escrow: we do NOT recommend Redwood holding customer private keys. If EdgeHealth requires escrow, legal must draft an explicit escrow SLA and a permit-to-use process. Alternatively, EdgeHealth can place CMK in a dedicated HSM-owned keyshare with Redwood having enforced policies (preferred).
4) Data minimization: confirm what fields will be redacted; any PII must be hashed with salted HMAC (EdgeHealth to provide salt or we document threat model).

Please surface any SOC2 / PCI concerns for the final language. Also add a Jira ticket (SUP-2345) for evidence retention automation; attach to the DocuSign package.

Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance and Trust
Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference>

Thanks all — summary and proposed plan: (action items below are for the POC only, revocable once the POC ends)

- Scope: deliver masked audit exports (auth + admin + inference access events) on a 1-hour batch cadence to EdgeHealth S3. EdgeHealth will manage S3 retention to 14d. (Option A)
- BYOK: allow customer CMK to encrypt exported blobs. No Redwood-held private escrow. Naomi to draft acceptable escrow alternatives and language for DocuSign.
- Evidence path: create an export ledger (timestamp, file name, checksum, delivery receipt) retained 180d. Attach to Jira SUP-2345.
- Owners & ETA: Priyom to prototype export job (ETA: 2 weeks), Kim to document ops checklist + IAM, Naomi to prepare DocuSign amendment and compliance checklist (ETA: 5 business days).
- Next: schedule 30-minute triage call w/ EdgeHealth Monday 10/5 at 10am PT — Mike, does that work?

Please confirm ownership and I will open the Jira and the DocuSign draft.

-David
David Kim
